samples.summary: Theme-value validation is scope creep relative to issue #584
samples.evidence: The originating task doc (docs/tasks/active/20260812-date-display-format-todo.md) scopes the change to document-list-utils.ts, date-format-preference.ts, document-list.tsx, settings/page.tsx and their tests; nothing about the theme. This delta adds `isTheme()`/validated `readStoredTheme` plus two new ThemeProvider tests. It is a plausible hardening of the localStorage pattern the PR introduced, but it is unrequested behavior in a PR whose acceptance criteria are all about the documents-list date column — it would be better as its own change so the date-format PR stays reviewable against its criteria.

samples.summary: `DateCell` is exported from a route component file solely to make it testable
samples.evidence: `function DateCell` becomes `export function DateCell` with the only consumer being tests/app/documents/date-cell.test.tsx. Widening a page module's public surface for test access (rather than extracting the cell into its own module next to document-list-utils.ts, where the rest of the testable date logic already lives) is a fit/shape concern: it also puts the export at risk with knip, whose frontend entry/project globs are `tests/**/*.test.ts` only (knip.json:18-19), so a `.tsx`-only consumer may not count as usage.

samples.summary: Design doc's Browser-Persisted Preferences section not updated for the new theme-value validation
samples.evidence: frontend.md documents the shared localStorage-preference pattern and says ThemeProvider 'applies the same two guards (readStoredTheme/writeStoredTheme)'. This delta adds a third rule to that pattern — validate the stored value before use, because an arbitrary token reaches classList.add and throws — which is now true for both preferences but is only documented for date-format (line 566-568). The canonical doc should record the validation rule alongside the guards so the next preference copies it.
